title: Currency Babington Smith Commission
definition: The Babington Smith Committee (1919) was a British-appointed commission tasked with recommending the future of Indian currency and exchange rates in the post-WWI economic landscape.
importanceInUpsc: It is a critical component of the 'Economic History of India' under British rule, specifically regarding the evolution of the Gold Exchange Standard and the impact of colonial monetary policy on Indian inflation and trade.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Currency Babington Smith Commission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Gold Standard vs. Gold Exchange Standard
Impact of WWI on Indian Economy
